user.title: Spiel Saison
user.description: Connection to the app “Spiel Saison Recorder” and the folder of the recordings. The address is shown on the app page under “Info → Hostname”, the key is the `api_key` from the app settings. Recordings go into the app folder under: base folder / folder per play partner / folder per season / file per camera. In the patterns you can use the placeholders partner, nr, saison, aufnahme, cam, cam_nr and ort, each in curly braces (cam and cam_nr only in the file name), plus date and time with %CCYY %MM %DD %hh %mm %ss.

data.season_pattern: Folder per season (date = start of the season)

reconfigure.title: Change connection and folders
reconfigure.description: New folder patterns apply from the next recording. Existing recordings stay where they are. Placeholders as during setup: partner, nr, saison, aufnahme, cam, cam_nr and ort, each in curly braces, plus date and time with %CCYY %MM %DD %hh %mm %ss.

user.title: New play partner
user.description: Every play partner has their own seasons, counters and folder. The cameras belong to the places you add for them afterwards. The number appears in the folder and the file name, for example as 02. The nickname is optional. For the preferences you type your own entries and confirm each with Enter. Everything you ever entered is offered for every further play partner. Every preference gets an entry under “Diagnostic” on the play partner's device. Preferences for working also get an “included” switch and a counter. The announcement is optional: it goes through a notify entity, for example an Echo, when a recording starts and ends. In the texts you can use the placeholders nickname, partner, nr, saison and ort, each in curly braces.

data.name: Name
data.likes: Own preferences (type and confirm with Enter)
data.treats: Preferences for working on their partner (type and confirm with Enter)

reconfigure.title: Edit play partner
reconfigure.description: Change name, number, nickname, preferences and announcement. New preferences get their entries on the device when you save, removed ones disappear there. Counters and season are kept. Existing recordings stay in their folder, new ones go to the folder with the changed name. The cameras are set at the places. In the announcements you can use the placeholders nickname, partner, nr, saison and ort, each in curly braces.

user.title: New place
user.description: A place is where a play partner plays, for example bed or swing. It brings the cameras that record there. On start the integration moves the Ctronics cameras to their PTZ position, switches lights and devices and waits for the lead time before the recording begins. On end it waits for the pause and puts everything back. The next step lets you choose the PTZ position of each Ctronics camera, then what is switched.

data.name: Name
data.lead_seconds: Lead time between start and recording
data.end_seconds: Pause between end of recording and end step

user_ptz.title: PTZ position per camera
user_ptz.description: For each Ctronics camera of this place you choose the stored position it moves to on start. The names come from the options of the Ctronics 4K Cam integration. Without names the numbers 1 to 64 are offered. “Do not move” leaves the camera where it is. Other cameras are not moved and do not appear here.

user_begin.title: Prepare and start
user_begin.description: Everything is optional. You can choose entities, devices, areas or labels, also scenes and scripts. “Prepare” runs when you press the “Prepare” button. The cover, winch or similar moves to the position then. On start the targets under “Turn off” are turned off first, then the ones under “Turn on” are turned on.

user_end.title: End
user_end.description: Everything is optional. After the pause the targets under “Turn off” are turned off first, then the ones under “Turn on” are turned on. Only the “Save place” button saves the place.

reconfigure.title: Edit place
reconfigure.description: Change the settings of the place. The next step has the PTZ positions of the cameras, then the targets that are switched.

start_recording.name: Start recording
start_recording.description: Starts the recording of a play partner: start step of the place, lead time, then the recording.

place.description: Name of the place of this play partner. Without it the place chosen on the play partner's device is used.

stop_recording.name: Stop recording
stop_recording.description: Stops the recording of a play partner and then runs the end step of the place.

prepare.name: Prepare place
prepare.description: Begins the season of the day if there is none for today yet, creates the season folder in the target folder if it is missing, turns on the targets for preparing the place and moves the cover or winch, without recording.

place.name: Place
place.description: Name of the place of this play partner. Without it the place chosen on the play partner's device is used.

new_season.name: Start new season
new_season.description: Raises the season number of a play partner and resets the counters and the statistics of the season. This works only once a day: if there is already a season for today, nothing changes.
